text: Occupation: Career Education Manager

My parents came here as refugees and chose Rosemead to build our future. They worked hard and from the age of four, I spoke up for my family. Opportunity isn't something families find on their own. It's built by strong schools, safe streets, and a City Hall that listens.
Every family deserves the opportunities that helped mine. I'll fight for a Rosemead where families can afford to stay, seniors can age with dignity, and small businesses can grow.

I'm proof of what happens when a community invests in its youth: public schools and a full scholarship made me a first-generation college graduate. At Bank of America, I managed budgets and analyzed risk, and I've mentored young people in STEM and civics through CAUSE and BioscienceLA.

As your Councilwoman, I'll read the City's budget line by line, ask hard questions before we spend, and compete for the state and federal dollars Rosemead is leaving on the table. I'll modernize a City Hall where you still can't pay for a permit online, expand multilingual services, and bring a real plan to encourage businesses along Valley Blvd and Garvey Ave.
With gratitude, I ask for your vote. More information: VoteDianaLam.com

text: Occupation: Business Owner/Commissioner

I'm humbly asking for your vote for Rosemead City Council. I've had the privilege of serving this community before and serving two terms as your Mayor. I would be honored to have your support once again.

My priorities for Rosemead are simple – improve public safety, enhance recreation opportunities, and implement a common-sense economic development plan. I have a proven track-record of getting things done and have concrete ideas for how to make our city safer, upgrade our parks, and bring new shopping, small businesses, and dining experiences to Rosemead.

It is important that I acknowledge my past. I've certainly made mistakes. I fully accept responsibility for those prior actions and I do regret having let so many people down. But I am a better leader and person today because of those experiences. It is my sincere hope that my actions and record of late, as well as the overwhelming support from so many community members and neighborhood leaders across Rosemead, has enabled me to re-earn your confidence.
Rosemead is an amazing City. Together, I know we can implement our shared vision to create a community that respects the past while fully embracing the future.
John Tran, Former Mayor

text: Occupation: Mayor of Rosemead/District Representative
Rosemead is the only home I have known. I grew up here, attended our local schools, and played youth sports. Serving my beloved hometown has been the greatest honor of my life.
Thank you for trusting me to serve as your Councilwoman for the past 17 years. As your Councilwoman and Mayor, I have worked to make Rosemead safer, stronger, and more vibrant.

Together, we increased police patrols, improved emergency response times, expanded parks and recreation programs, invested in neighborhood improvements, and maintained responsible fiscal management. Because of these efforts, Rosemead was ranked number one in the San Gabriel Valley for financial stability. I am proud to celebrate our city's diversity by supporting community traditions, including the 1st Annual Taste of Rosemead, Mid-Autumn Moon Festival, Fall Fiesta/Día de los Muertos, and our Fourth of July Parade, Festival, and Fireworks Celebration. I have dedicated my life to serving Rosemead as a recreation leader, Garvey School District teacher, Mayor, and Councilwoman. I understand the challenges facing working families and remain committed to protecting public safety, maintaining financial responsibility, and preserving Rosemead's quality of life. I humbly ask for your vote to continue serving you.

text: Age: 41
Occupation: Councilmember, City of Rosemead/Army Reserve/Taxpayer Advocate

I grew up in Rosemead, attended Rosemead schools, and have spent my life serving the public. As your Rosemead Council Member since 2009, I have delivered results: better police response times by up to 27%, brought in over $8 million in state and federal funds for our community, and created five new parks.

As a UCLA graduate, the first in my family to earn a college degree, I understand what it means to sacrifice, work hard, and invest in the future. As an officer in the United States Army Reserves, I served overseas, commanding 148 soldiers, clearing potentially explosive devices and managing large-scale construction projects in Iraq and Syria. I understand leading under pressure.

As Taxpayer Advocate, I helped over 700 taxpayers resolve tax problems and ensured they received back every tax dollar due to them, helping make their lives little more affordable. I bring that same commitment to every City Council meeting.

My priorities are: safe and secure neighborhoods, protect your hard-earned tax dollars, build more quality parks and recreation, and make sure Rosemead values are protected in state and regional planning.
Rosemead is my home. I am asking for the honor of continuing to serve.
